relationships.subject: vTRN PV+ neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: The results showed that the activation of PV+ neurons in vTRN increased the mechanical threshold and thermal latency, which indicated reduction of pain sensitivity.

relationships.subject: dTRN PV+ neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: Our previous findings showed that activating parvalbumin-positive (PV+) neurons in dorsal sector of TRN (dTRN) could reduce the pain threshold and consequently increase the pain sensitivity of mice.

relationships.subject: vTRN PV+ neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: The fibers of these neurons mainly projected to ventral posterolateral thalamic nucleus (VPL), ventral posteromedial thalamic nucleus (VPM), ventrolateral thalamic nucleus (VL), centrolateral thalamic nucleus (CL) and various other brain regions.

key_findings: Chemogenetic activation of PV+ neurons in ventral TRN increased mechanical threshold and thermal latency, reducing pain sensitivity in mice.
vTRN PV+ neurons project mainly to VPL, VPM, VL and CL thalamic nuclei.
